notes: I changed the case transform: instead of capitalizing the whole string then inserting, the string is split at the original midpoint first, the left half is `.capitalize()`d and the right half is `.lower()`d. This explains why `"ßßßß"` → `"Ssß10ßß"` (left `"ßß"`→`"Ssß"`, right `"ßß"`→`"ßß"`), which the old whole-string-then-split model got wrong.
